chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
The shroud of a woman is upon her husband if she dies.

key_terms.عَلَى زَوْجِهَا: an obligation binding upon her husband
key_terms.كَفَنُ الْمَرْأَةِ: the funeral shroud of a woman

ai.seo_question: Who is responsible for a woman’s shroud when she dies in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that when a married woman dies, the cost and provision of her shroud are the responsibility of her husband. It reflects a fiqh ruling connected to spousal obligations at the time of death.
